transformers.note: Ran under 4.57.6 in practice; the model card's requirement has not been transcribed. Grade it before release.

resources._note: 58 GiB of MoE weights on one 80 GiB card left too little room for vision activations: long clips peaked ~17 GiB of live tensors mid-forward and 11% of stress calls failed to allocate ~6 GiB more. The dense 32B ran clean on one card; the MoE's activation profile is what differs. Two cards halve replica count, which its 3B-active speed easily affords.
